text:
Aisha: Drafting a lightweight endpoint metrics card for Console — shows p50/p95/p99 token-latency, throughput (rps), error rate, and kv-cache-hit per route. Quick mock in Figma. Thoughts on the exact metrics we need for per-route troubleshooting?
Samir: Love it. Two asks: 1) token-level latency waterfall (kernel, kv, decoder). 2) spike attribution: batching vs kernel selection vs cache miss.
Priya: Agree. For the token waterfall we should emit three spans per token: preproc, kernel_exec, kv_lookup. We already emit kernel_latency & kv_latency counters but need per-token histograms to compute p50/p95/p99 properly.
Jonah: Are we planning to store these as Prometheus histograms or rely on OTLP traces? Histograms let Console show p50/p95 quickly; traces for sampled deep dives.
Aisha: Prometheus histograms for p50/p95/p99 + small quantile series for distribution. Traces will be sampled for correlated stacks and user-level debugging. Console can link traces from the card.
Samir: Proposed PromQL snippets to include in the dashboard cookbook:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_span_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/embed",job="runtime"}[5m])) by (le))
sum(rate(kernel_exec_duration_seconds_count{route="/embed"}[5m]))
```
Also we need kernel_version and kv_hit labels on metrics so we can break down the spikes.
Priya: KV cache hit rate query (5m): `sum(rate(kv_hits_total{route="/embed"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_requests_total{route="/embed"}[5m]))` -> show as percent + trend sparkline.
Aisha: UI layout idea: summary row with p50 / p95 / p99 chips, two mini-sparklines (rps and error rate), small donut for kernel selection, and a waterfall popover that shows stacked p50/p95 per-span.
runtime-bot: deploy-bot: metric token_span_latency_seconds added to runtime on canary cluster `abc123`.
Jonah: Also surface kernel selection distribution: fraction of requests served by `fp16-ker`, `int8-ker`, `fallback-cpu`. Stacked bar or donut with hover counts, plus a trend line for regressions.
Samir: UX note: default aggregation should be by route. Provide quick toggles to group-by `model_version`, `kernel`, or `region`.
Priya: Implementation note: per-token histograms are high-cardinality. We'll use fixed bucket histograms and limit label cardinality (no per-request ids). For traces, reservoir sampling with 1% default.
Aisha: Next steps: I'll update the Figma & upload a dashboard JSON draft. @Jonah can you spec a tracing link contract? @Samir please ensure runtime emits `kernel`, `model_version`, `kv_hit` labels in the next PR.
Jonah: On it — will add OTEL span names `token.preproc`, `token.kv`, `token.kernel`, `token.postproc` and attribute `kernel.selection`. Also add a trace-level tag `route`.
Samir: I'll open the runtime PR tomorrow morning and include the PromQLs and example grafana/dash JSON. cc @Priya for correctness on kv math.
Priya: Will review. Small performance caveat — cache warmup will bias p50 early after deploy. We should surface a "stable window" filter and annotate rollout times.
Aisha: Nice catch. We'll add an annotation bar for rollout windows and a small note about skew. Closing this thread once I attach the figma + dashboard JSON. Thanks all :rocket:
